item.title: Thirteen killed in Israeli strikes on southern Lebanon, health ministry says
item.description: Four women and a child are among the dead, as fighting between Israel and Iran-backed Hezbollah continues despite a ceasefire.

item.title: Israel strikes Beirut for first time since Hezbollah ceasefire
item.description: Israel says it targeted a senior Hezbollah figure in the capital, the first strike of its kind since mid-April.

item.title: Bowen: Strait of Hormuz standoff raises risk of sliding back into all-out war
item.description: The US and Iran's determination to keep the pressure on each other has put the fragile Gulf ceasefire in serious jeopardy.

item.title: US strikes Iranian fast boats as Iran attacks UAE oil facility
item.description: Shipping company Maersk says one of its US-flagged commercial vessels has successfully exited the Strait of Hormuz under US military protection.

item.title: Israeli attacks kill dozens within days in Lebanon despite ceasefire
item.description: The health ministry says 110 people have been killed in Israeli strikes on southern Lebanon since Thursday.

item.title: 3 חברי כנור שחימו
item.description: They are among nine people killed in successive attacks on Tuesday, which Israel's military says targeted a Hezbollah commander.

item.title: Some Iranians fear the regime is now more entrenched - and ready for revenge
item.description: Ordinary Iranians tell of worry about increased repression by authorities after the war is over.

item.title: Far-right Israeli minister condemned for taunting handcuffed Gaza flotilla activists
item.description: France and Italy are among the countries that have criticised a video showing Itamar Ben-Gvir taunting dozens of activists detained at an Israeli port.

item.title: BBC traces how 10 minutes of Israeli bombing brought devastation to Lebanon
item.description: The bombs started falling at 14:15 in the afternoon - bringing chaos and destruction across the country.
